entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • The ShellContent IsEnabledProperty property does not work #30102
  • Shell navigation using `ShellContent` items in a `Tab` incorrectly navigates to last `ShellContent` #30100
  • Clip on iOS does not affect shadow #30099
  • App crash on iOS version 15.8.4 #30098
  • Cannot Clear All Map Polygons (Android Only) #30097
  • [Catalyst] Scrollbar does not align with FlowDirection change in ScrollView #30095
  • [MAUI]Memory Leak in ListView Control for .NET MAUI #30094
  • [macOS] VisualStateManager ForegroundColor State Not Applied #30093
  • ListView - Cells getting empty when switching away from the App, then coming back to resume #30091
  • DatePicker Does Not Update Its Format When the Culture Is Changed at Runtime #30090
  • Entry with IsPassword toggling loses previously entered text on iOS when IsPassword is re-enabled #30085
  • InputView with TextTransform="Uppercase" triggers TextChanged twice per character #30084
  • Collection view single preselection doesn't work in iOS application #30082
  • [Android] ScrollView scroll position changes unexpectedly when Orientation is set to Horizontal and FlowDirection is RTL at runtime #30081

Closed

  • MAUI and Razor components abstracted as a separate class library fail to build in .NET 10 Previews whereas .NET 9 works fine #28537
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • Datepicker focus and unfocus event not firing on android #18797
    Backlog
  • I1_Vertical_list_for_Multiple_Rows - Rotating the emulator would cause clipping on the description text. #29542
    .NET 9 SR9
  • I1 - Vertical list for Item Height- After rotating the Android emulator, some text boxes have extra blank space #29727
    .NET 9 Servicing

    .NET 9 SR9

    .NET 9 SR9

    .NET 10.0-preview6
  • Visual Studio Enterprise 2022 Version 17.14.5 Preview 1.0: .NET MAUI App Template doesn't ask to select .NET Version #29998
  • .resx AppResources Strings Suddenly Become Unavailable After Rebuild #30073
  • Does HybridWebView support external web content to invoke C# from JavaScript? #30064
  • Memory leak when replacing Window.Page without clearing Navigation stack #29893
